newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank vows to maintain policies.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank vows to maintain policies.

text.p: Bank of Thailand (BOT) governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Monday there would be no change in the central bank's monetary policies, even though a new government is set to take office.
"The BOT will continue our current monetary policies, there will be no change," Rerngchai told reporters.
Rerngchai urged the new government to include knowledgeable people in their economic team in order to rebuild investors' confidence.

"The negative reaction from the stock and foreign exchange markets today signal that the economic team of the new government should be careful and adopt the right economic policies," Rerngchai told reporters. "Otherwise, it will have an adverse affect on the overall economy."
Thai stock market plunged more than six percent at the open as investors reacted to Sunday's election result. The market was down nearly six percent, or 59.64 points, to 941.09 at 0855 GMT.
The New Aspiration Party (NAP) of caretaker Defence Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh won a two-seat victory over the Democrat Party in Sunday's general election.

The business community had wanted a Democrat win because the Democrats are seen to have a stronger group of economic experts who could help revive Thailand's sagging economy, analysts said. -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
